intent.proves: PIM dashboard with query-backed widgets: dashboard satisfies the selected profile assertion.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Dashboard d WHERE d.DashboardType = N'Products' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DashboardWidget w WHERE w.DashboardWidgetDashboardID = d.DashboardID) >= 4
